claim.quote: The measured flux of muon neutrinos is in very good agreement with predictions and no anomaly has been found in the ratio between the rate of electron and muon neutrino events.

date.quote: The NUSEK Collaboration et al 1989 EPL 8 611

name: Experimental Study of Atmospheric Neutrino Flux in the NUSEX Experiment

summary.plain: NUSEX counted the neutrino interactions fully inside its detector. The muon-neutrino flux matched predictions and the ratio of electron to muon events showed nothing unusual, so there was no hint yet of the atmospheric-neutrino anomaly seen later.
summary.technical: Fully contained events of the nucleon-stability data set analysed for flux anomalies: nu_mu flux in very good agreement with the calculation; no anomaly in the nu_e/nu_mu event-rate ratio.

title: Experimental Study of Atmospheric Neutrino Flux in the NUSEX Experiment
why_it_matters: One of the early underground checks of the atmospheric-neutrino flux, done before the anomaly that Super-Kamiokande later explained by oscillations.
